Q: How do I export a JavaScript project from Dashtera platform? A:

Interesting question. I can confirm, Dashtera's charts are LightningChart JS. Dashtera doesn't currently have a way to export the dashboard as JavaScript / LightningChart JS project. I'll forward the idea to be evaluated with the team.

For embedding Dashtera projects to your own off-line system, please consult Dashtera Support directly, for on-premises system setup.

For full disclosure, I'm part of Dashtera dev team.

Q: Git delete pushed commits A:

You'll have to revert those commits.

Technically what it does is that it removes those changes and makes a new commit, undoing them.

Now, reverting them will leave them on the history still, but usually that is OK. If that's totally unacceptable only then look at the solutions like filter-branch and force pushes.

Q: Using path with spaces in shell script A:

The script worked when used with the command eval, which preserves quotes and it didn't add any additional single quotes.

  D_ARG=`(tr '\r\n' ' ' < argument.dat)
 \#executing java code by passing above argument
  eval java ${D_ARG} TestProgram

Q: windowBackground not showing image on device A:

Make sure you have the picture on all folders. Namely, Drawable-hdpi, Drawable-mdpi, Drawable-xdpi, Drawable-xxdpi and Drawable-xxxdpi.
